_doc: Relaunch of run 45083226299 (cancelled) with the slots between rebuilt elements kept open in the CFD surfaces: the detail-zone wrap left 2-6 mm of the 10-13 mm MP4/23 rear-wing slot (and parts of the front-wing slots) solid. Pockets next to rebuilt (closed) elements: the one-piece rule does not apply and the slot air already reopened counts as open air for up to 3 more ray passes; wing zones split along the span; smallest rebuilt slot 6 mm. Local check MP4/23: rear-wing slot 8-13 mm along the span, front-wing slots 5-15 mm. Rebuilt wing elements on the MP4/23, RB12 and MP4/5 (geometry/wing_rebuild.py section mode, "wing_rebuild": true): each element is followed through cuts y = const of the model from a seed point and replaced by an inverted NACA 4-digit loft on the model's leading and trailing edges, chord and incidence, with the model's camber (clipped 2-9 %) and thickness (9-15 %); a flap keeps at least the model's slot gap to the element ahead. MP4/23: front wing 3 elements, rear wing 2, beam wing. RB12: front-wing centre plane and the 6-element outboard stack, rear wing 2 (endplate cascades and the 4 cm beam wing left as modelled). MP4/5: same 5 elements as mp45_w1 (still running, box mode with fixed 4 % / 6 % camber), now with the model's camber: an A/B of the section shape. Bargeboards reviewed and left as modelled (thin smooth plates). 3D = p14 settings; 2D sections at the p14 stations, also with 5 deg less incidence (iso_m5) as a first look at the angle reduction.
